title: Simple Contact Intake
purpose: A beginner-friendly sample that adds governed notification behavior to the basic concept + invariant + persistence pattern.
businessStory: A team wants to collect incoming contact messages and trigger a notification without hand-coded custom application logic.
walkthrough: Run the sample through the Step 50 one-command trial path.
Call GET /api/flows and confirm SubmitContactMessage exists.
POST the contact payload and inspect the execution result.
Inspect traces to see notification-related evidence.
expectedOutcomes: The contact message is validated and persisted.
A notification capability is invoked through governed runtime behavior.
The user sees a small but real business workflow beyond plain CRUD.
